symptom: Item 3 of saingge's comment on mendixlabs/mxcli#1517 (ako/mxcli#1399): under `mdl 1;` a re-run `create or modify` whose only change is a note added or reworded before an `if` is refused as 'the If at (360, 200) changes where its paths end or meet', and before the final `return` as 'the annotations on the Return at (1120, 200) change; the splice changes a return's value only'. A note on a plain activity is accepted
cause: A note change on an activity is spliced as a replace of the activity (RemoveNotes + Replace with the notes in the fragment). A decision and an end event are never replaced — only edited in place (SetCondition, SetReturnValue) — and the mutator had no op to attach a note to a node that stays, so the diff refused: the if fell through gap()'s catch-all, the return hit endEvent's annotation check
file: mdl/backend/mfmutator/splice.go (AddNotes), mdl/backend/microflow_mutation.go (interface), mdl/backend/mcp/microflow_mutator.go (refused), mdl/executor/cmd_flow_modify.go (ifConditionChanged, conditionEdit, endEvent, nodeNotes), mdl/executor/flow_splice_node_notes.go (setNodeNotes), mdl/executor/cmd_alter_flow.go (applyTo), mdl/ast/ast_alter_flow.go (SetNotes)
fix: New mutator op AddNotes(target, frag): frag is a stand-in object plus the notes the builder drew against it; unpinned notes are translated by the stand-in's offset from the target, lines are pointed at the target, nothing else changes. The diff treats a decision's or an end event's notes as a property set in place: a SetNotes op (RemoveNotes, then AddNotes with notes built against a stand-in `log`), alongside SetCondition / the return value. Shared notes (id:) are still refused
test: mdl/backend/mfmutator/splice_notes_add_test.go (stored objects byte-identical, note moved with the node, pinned note kept, stand-in not written; refusal); mdl/executor/flow_splice_node_notes_pedapp_test.go TestCreateOrModify_NotesOnADecisionOrEndEvent (decision note added/reworded/taken off, end event note; node $ID kept, others not rebuilt, describe prints the short form so the note is at its default place, re-run Unchanged; control: shared note refused). Before the implementation every subtest failed with the two reported messages
insight: Building notes against a stand-in `log` gives exactly the geometry a full build gives the real node, because defaultAnnotationGeometry clamps the target height up to an activity's — so no per-node-type placement code was needed; the describe-prints-short-form assertion is the check that this holds. The 2026-10-21 note-only-splice finding had already named the missing AddNotes op as the open item
